                grid[(gr, gc)] = 'P'

            elif n['color'] in ('W', 'g'):
                grid[(gr, gc)] = '#'
            elif n['color'] == 'B':
                grid[(gr, gc)] = 'D'

for gr in range(5):
    row = ''
    for gc in range(13):
        row += grid.get((gr, gc), '?')
    print(f"Row {gr}: {row}")
